    elif len(inputs) == 3:

    else:
        raise ValueError("inputs must contain 2 or 3 tensors")

    return torch.conv_transpose1d(
        input=input_tensor,
        weight=weight,
        bias=bias,
        stride=stride,
        padding=padding,
        output_padding=output_padding,
        groups=groups,
        dilation=dilation
    )
